scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Haha, I have seen many people
but it seems you possess special power and abilities.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
Haha，我閱人無數，而你似乎擁有非凡的力量與本領。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
What brings you here? Is there anything bothering you recently?
Although you're already a Sage, that doesn't mean you can stop studying.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你來這裡有什麼事？
最近遇到什麼煩心事了嗎？
雖說你已經是賢者，也不能就此停止學習。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hahah, so my little Novice, what brings you this way? ...I guess you're on a sightseeing trip?
You must have had a really hard time to reach this place. I must say, you seem interested in the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
Hahah，小初心者，你怎麼到這裡來了？
...是來觀光的嗎？
一路來到這裡，想必吃了不少苦吧。
看來你對賢者這個職業很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Although we've been studying this world for a long time, I know that studying in itself will fulfill all the needs of the people.
Other classes are just as important to the welfare of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
*Chuckle* 雖然我們研究這個世界已有很長時間，但我知道，學習本身就能滿足人們的一切需求。
其他職業對盧恩·米德加茲的福祉也同樣重要...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Welcome, young one. I can see that you're intrigued by the wonders of magic.
So what kind of business brings you to me?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
歡迎你，年輕人。
看得出你對魔法的奧秘很感興趣。
那麼，找我有什麼事呢？

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你似乎還不符合條件。
記住，職業等級至少達到40，才能成為賢者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You possess remaining skill points...
Before you submit your dissertation, please take care this matter first.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你還有未分配的技能點...
提交論文前，請先把技能點分配完。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ho~ So? Did you finally complete your dissertation? Well done.
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
哦~ 怎麼樣？
終於完成論文了嗎？
做得好。
讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm? What has happened to you? Where did you leave your dissertation?
Please bring it to me so that you may pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
嗯？
這是怎麼回事？
你把論文放哪兒了？
請把論文帶來，才能通過考核。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Becoming a Sage isn't as simple as you may have assumed.
You cannot become a Sage because your magic skills are inadequate...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
*Chuckle* 成為賢者可沒有你想的那麼簡單。
你的魔法本領還不足以成為賢者...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You'd better leave and increase your reputation.
Never forget that once you also used to be a novice.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你還是先去提升自己的聲望吧。
永遠別忘了，你也曾是一名初心者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Our knowledge is the mainspring of activity which helps the kingdom to be developed faster.
Please keep this in mind: you must study and record everything you've discovered so that all in the kingdom may benefit.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
我們的知識是推動王國加速發展的動力。
請牢記：你必須不斷學習，記錄自己的一切發現，讓王國的所有人都能從中受益。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
If you aspire to become a Sage, you must first live life as a Mage. Only then shall you have a chance.
I am looking forward seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
如果你立志成為賢者，就得先成為魔法師，積累歷練。
只有這樣，你才有機會。
期待與你再次相見。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
However, if you happen to meet a Sage down the road, I hope you will lend him your assistance.
And if you do, he shall repay you in kind...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
不過，如果你在旅途中遇到賢者，希望你能伸出援手。
他也會回報你的善意...

scripts.text: I would like to be a Sage.
scripts.translation: 我想成為賢者

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 瞭解賢者轉職

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hm? Do you wish to become a Sage?
Well then, I would like to suggest a few things that are required of a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
嗯？
你想成為賢者？
那我就先說說成為賢者需要滿足哪些條件。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sages are those who promote the development of this continent through the endless studying and recording of all knowledge related to this world.
Becoming a Sage is more than just a costume change: It's an important job where you must be always aware of your duty and responsibility to the people.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
賢者不斷研究並記錄這個世界的各種知識，以此推動大陸的發展。
成為賢者，可不只是換一身衣服。
這是一份重要的職責，你必須時刻牢記自己對人民的責任與義務。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You may want to enter an enrollment application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I believe they can explain in detail what you need to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你可以向施韋希比爾魔法學院提交入學申請。
他們應該能詳細告訴你，成為賢者需要滿足哪些條件。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sage job change...hmm...an interesting turn of phrase, I must say.
Although that is what we say, it is very inappropriate to think of becoming a Sage as merely changing a job.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
賢者轉職...嗯...這說法倒有意思。
雖說我們也這樣稱呼，但把成為賢者僅僅當作換個職業，可就大錯特錯了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
In order to be a Sage, you must enter an application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
You will then take the entrance examination.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
要成為賢者，你得先向施韋希比爾魔法學院提交入學申請。
之後再參加入學考試。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
After the examination, you will be assigned to study a specific subject...
and finally, you will submit your dissertation to the university.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
通過考試後，你會被安排研究某個課題...
最後，向學院提交你的論文。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I am the one who evaluates your dissertation.
When you pass all the courses, you will become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
你的論文由我評審。
通過全部課程後，你就能成為賢者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Please visit the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
A young Sage named Metheus Sylphe will accept your application.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
請前往施韋希比爾魔法學院。
那裡有位名叫梅修斯·西爾菲的年輕賢者，會受理你的申請。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I see...Well, seeing as you have leisure time to spare, I encourage you to peruse as many books as you can.
You can find and research every worldly matter within their pages.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
這樣啊...既然有閒暇，不妨多讀些書。
世間萬事萬物，都可以在書中探尋、研究。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ah yes, you can not become the most intelligent person merely by reading all the books around you...
However, for a Sage such as myself, the knowledge found in books is most important.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
當然，就算讀遍身邊所有的書，也不能讓你成為最聰明的人...
不過，對我這樣的賢者而言，書中的知識至關重要。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Huh...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
咦...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Interesting...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
有意思...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Although it's roughly written, it's well done for a beginner.
Ah yes...you seem to be proficient in studying.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
雖然行文略顯粗糙，但作為初學者，已經寫得很不錯了。
嗯...看來你很善於鑽研。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Congratulations! You have now become a Sage.
Always remember to keep a studious and analytical mindset.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
恭喜！
你現在是一名賢者了。
記得始終勤於學習，善於分析。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Also, keep this dissertation and treat it with care, since it is one and only book you have written.
You may have need of it one of these days. And it shall forever remind of this grandiose moment.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
另外，請珍惜並妥善保管這篇論文，畢竟這是你寫成的唯一一本書。
也許將來會有用到它的一天。
它也會永遠讓你銘記這一光榮的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Well then...May God fill your path with knowledge.
Study with diligence!!
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
那麼...願神讓你的前路充滿知識。
勤奮學習吧！！

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Wait...you didn't lose it, did you?
Well...that's your business. It is regrettable that you won't be able to get a chance to write a book anymore.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
等等...你不會把它弄丟了吧？
唉...那是你自己的事。
可惜，你再也沒有機會寫書了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Study diligently, and return when you finish your dissertation.
Until then, farewell!
scripts.translation:
[凱隆·格里克]
用心鑽研，完成論文後再回來吧。
到時再見！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the
Schweicherbil Magic
Academy. W-wait a second...
Do I know you from somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎來到施韋希比爾魔法學院。
等、等一下...
我們是不是在哪兒見過？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh nice to meet you again, long time no see.
So how's it going with the studying?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
哦，又見面了，真高興。
好久不見，最近學習得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎來到施韋希比爾魔法學院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Oh, You're a Mage. How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎來到施韋希比爾魔法學院。
哦，你是魔法師啊。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome, once again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎再次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Huh? What are you doing here? You're supposed to be taking the entrance test by now.
Please visit Professor Claytos in the left room.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
咦？
你怎麼還在這裡？
這會兒你應該在參加入學考試才對。
請去左邊的房間找克雷托斯教授。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, are you done with the dissertation?
Sure, you can submit it to Dean Kayron.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
哦，論文寫完了嗎？
那就交給凱隆院長吧。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh sorry, this is a rather inconvenient time to converse.
Please come back later. I apologize for troubling you.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
抱歉，現在不太方便交談。
請稍後再來。
讓你白跑一趟，真是不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
We've met before, haven't
we? Oh gosh, I must sound
pretty crazy. I'm sorry, I guess it's because I haven't been
sleeping too well? Oh well,
have a good day, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
我們以前見過，對吧？
天哪，我這話聽著一定很莫名其妙。
抱歉，大概是最近沒睡好吧？
算了，祝你今天愉快，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
It's okay to study books and magic scrolls all day, 
but you must go outside and fight with monsters as much as you can in order to be a well experienced Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
整天研究書籍和魔法卷軸當然可以，但要成為經驗豐富的賢者，還得多出去和魔物實戰。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you know any Sage candidates, please give them some advice...
Also, please give my regards to your colleagues as well.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
如果認識準備成為賢者的人，請給他們一些指點...
也請代我向你的同行們問好。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. Mostly, what we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
We always welcome new students.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
這裡專門培養賢者。
我們主要研究魔物與魔法咒語。
隨時歡迎新生加入。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
By passing selected courses, we will then approve them as Sages.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
職業等級達到40的魔法師，就有資格申請入學。
通過指定課程後，我們便會認可他們成為賢者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you're interested in the Sage class, please come again.
And have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
如果對賢者這個職業感興趣，歡迎再來。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. What we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
這裡專門培養賢者。
我們研究魔物與魔法咒語。
職業等級達到40的魔法師，就有資格申請入學。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you have any Mage friends, please let them know about this academy.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
如果你有魔法師朋友，請向他們介紹這所學院。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 瞭解賢者轉職

scripts.text: I want to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation: 我想報名入學

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see. Do you wish to become a Sage?
Unfortunately, we are not in charge of changing your job to the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
原來如此。
你想成為賢者？
不過很遺憾，我們並不直接辦理賢者轉職。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you enter this academy and pass certain courses...
you will receive official approval to conduct studies as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
進入本學院並通過規定的課程後...
你便會獲得正式認可，以賢者的身份開展研究。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For this reason, we do not speak of this proccess as a job change, but as graduation.
Anyway, if you enter your application for this academy, I will inform you about the registration fee and will let you take the test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
因此，我們不把這個過程稱為轉職，而是畢業。
總之，提交入學申請後，我會向你說明報名費，並安排你參加考試。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For your information, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, 
you don't have to pay for the Registration Fee to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
順便說一下，如果帶來^3355FF古魔法書^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，就可以免交入學報名費。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you register, you will be able to take the entrance test.
If you pass the test, you will write a thesis for a given subject.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
報名後，你就可以參加入學考試。
通過考試後，需要就指定課題撰寫論文。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The Dean of the academy will decide whether or not you are qualified.
If you're granted admission, you will be able to join in study and research activities as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
院長會決定你是否合格。
獲得認可後，你就能以賢者的身份參與學習與研究。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You're always welcome to join us.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
我們隨時歡迎你加入。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see, you want to join the academy. Once again, welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
原來你想入學啊。
再次歡迎你來到施韋希比爾魔法學院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who have already met the basic requirement by reaching at Mage job level 40 are qualified for enrollment.
A small registration fee will also be required.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
魔法師的職業等級達到40，就滿足了入學的基本條件。
此外，還需要繳納一筆報名費。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The registration fee is 70,000 zeny.
However, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, you will be exempt from this fee.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
報名費為70,000 Zeny。
不過，如果帶來^3355FF古魔法書^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，就可以免交這筆費用。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
So, do you wish to apply immediately?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
那麼，要現在申請嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 立即申請

scripts.text: The fee is much too expensive.
scripts.translation: 費用太貴了

scripts.text: I will come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I'm sorry, but you haven't met the basic requirements yet.
Please go study more and reach Mage job level 40 first.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
抱歉，你還不符合基本入學條件。
請繼續學習，等魔法師的職業等級達到40再來。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You have unused skill points left. Please go learn all those skills you've been planning to learn.
We do not accept any ambiguous candidates.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
你還有未分配的技能點。
請先學好你打算學習的技能。
我們不接受目標不明確的申請者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Very well. Let's complete your application form.
Please put your signature here.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
好的，我們來填好申請表吧。
請在這裡簽名。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Your name is ... {0}. It's a very nice name.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
你的名字是...{0}。
真是個好名字。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, you've mastered the Mage job! You're great!! *Clap Clap Clap*
In reward for your great effort, you will be exempt from the registration fee!
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
哦，你已經完全掌握魔法師的本領了！
真了不起！！*Clap Clap Clap*
為獎勵你的努力，我們將免除你的報名費！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Yes, everything's ready.
Next, you will take an entrance test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]

submit your thesis to Dean Kayron.

Welcome. How have you been?
I guess you've been through a lot of hard times...I can tell by your appearance.

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
歡迎來到施韋希比爾魔法學院。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I am Professor Hermes, in charge of practical examinations.
Are you a candidate for the Sage class?
scripts.translation:

你是準備成為賢者的學生嗎？

scripts.text:

I am professor Hermes, in charge of practical examinations.
Are you a candidate for the Sage class?
scripts.translation:

我是負責實操考試的赫爾墨斯教授。
你是準備成為賢者的學生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome, you just passed the written test, didn't you?
Now it's time for the practical examination.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
歡迎，你剛通過筆試，對吧？
現在該參加實操考試了。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Welcome again! So, did you fully prepare yourself this time?
Oh well, it's not that hard. Give it your all, okay?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
歡迎回來！
這次準備充分了嗎？
其實沒那麼難，全力以赴就好，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Good job~ Since you passed the practical examination as well...
I'll accept your admission.
scripts.translation:

做得好~既然實操考試也通過了...
我就批准你入學。

scripts.text:

Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:

咦？
你沒聽懂我的話嗎？
我讓你去研究天地樹。

scripts.text:

Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study monsters.
scripts.translation:

咦？你沒聽懂我說的話嗎？
我讓你去研究魔物。

scripts.text:

Huh? Didn't you understand what I said?
I told you to study magic spells that possess certain properties.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
咦？你沒聽懂我說的話嗎？
我讓你去研究具有特定屬性的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be with Dean Kayron?
Oh well, there's no harm in showing me your dissertation though...
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
你怎麼還在這裡？
不是該去找凱隆院長嗎？
不過，讓我看看你的論文也無妨...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Oh sorry, I'm quite busy at the moment...
If you have any questions, go visit the professor I've assigned to you.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
抱歉，我現在很忙...
有問題就去找我為你安排的教授。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I know how hard it is to explore all those perilous areas, but it will help you to gain more knowledge.
Book smarts never can beat street smarts.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
我知道探索那些險地並不容易，但這能讓你增長見識。
書本知識終究比不上親身實踐。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
However, it's a very dangerous idea to go deep inside a dungeon alone. 
You'd better look for trustworthy comrades.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
不過，獨自深入地下城可是很危險的。
最好找些可靠的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
In this continent of Rune-Midgarts, there are a lot of unknown places and objects that haven't been fully discovered.
The monsters, mysterious objects and heroes of myths...
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
盧恩·米德加茲大陸上，還有許多尚未被充分探索的地方和事物。
魔物、神秘的物品，還有神話中的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Why don't you consider being a Sage in the future?
You will love studying the world.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
不妨考慮將來成為賢者吧？
你會愛上探索這個世界的。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
If by chance you do decide to do that, we'll meet again.
Take care, kiddy.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
如果真有這個打算，我們還會再見的。
保重，小傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
We Sages are more like scholars than Mages.
We are very helpful and powerful as members of a party.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
比起魔法師，我們賢者更像學者。
在隊伍中，我們既能發揮強大的力量，也能提供有力的支援。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Try to make a party with a Sage next time.
The wisdom a Sage will bring will be more than helpful for your party...
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
下次試著和賢者組隊吧。
賢者的智慧一定能為隊伍帶來莫大的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Register your application and take the written test first.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
先辦好入學申請，再參加筆試。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Go pass the written test with Professor Claytos first.
Then I will take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
先通過克雷托斯教授的筆試。
之後再由我來考核你。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
There is nothing difficult or special about this test.
All you have to do is kill all the monsters within the time limit.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
這場考試沒什麼難懂的，也沒什麼特別之處。
你只需要在規定時間內消滅所有魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
It's better to experience this for yourself, rather than be told about this test 100 times.
How about it? Are you ready to take this test?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
聽我講一百遍，也不如親自試一次。
怎麼樣？
準備好參加考試了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 準備好了

scripts.text: Sorry, give me some time.
scripts.translation: 請再給我一點時間

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Good, let's start immediately.
Do your best and come back safely!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
很好，我們馬上開始。
全力以赴，平安回來！

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Yes, you don't need to hurry... take your time and come back.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
好，不必著急...
準備好了再來吧。

scripts.text:

Are you ready?

scripts.text:

Now I need to decide what subject you will learn and study...
Let's see... let me check your written test grade and the time spent on the practical examination.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
現在，我得決定讓你研究什麼課題...
讓我看看...先核對一下你的筆試成績和實操考試用時。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Hmm, hmm... I see.
Well... I think you're okay.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
嗯，嗯...明白了。
好吧...我覺得你還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now, you will study Yggdrasil.
Yggdrasil is the tree that was rumored to be the source of life for this world.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
接下來，你將研究天地樹。
傳說這棵樹是這個世界的生命之源。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
That is a good subject which helps us to recognize changes in the world, as well as the direction of its improvement.
Go ask for help from Professor Saphien. He's in the Lecture Room.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
這是個很有意義的課題，能幫助我們瞭解世界的變化及其發展方向。
去請教薩菲恩教授吧。
他在講堂裡。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I wish you luck.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Now, you will study monsters.
The purpose of this study is to learn and understand more about creatures existing all over the continent.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
接下來，你將研究魔物。
這項研究旨在加深對大陸各地生物的認識與瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
This is a good subject which will help you lead your life as a well-experienced Sage.
Go ask for help from Professor Lucius. He's in the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:

這是個很有意義的課題，能幫助你成為經驗豐富的賢者。
去請教盧修斯教授吧。
他在魔物博物館。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
I wish you luck.
scripts.translation:

祝你好運。

接下來，你將研究帶有特定屬性的魔法。
這項研究旨在加深對日常使用的基礎魔法的理解。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
That is a good subject which helps you to deeply understand of the truth of magic.
Go ask Professor Aebecee for help...He's in the Somatology Laboratory.
scripts.translation:

這是個很有意義的課題，能幫助你深入理解魔法的真諦。
去請教艾貝西教授吧...
他在人體實驗室。

他在人體實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
But then again, maybe there is. Go see Dean Kayron.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾墨斯·特里斯]
不過話說回來，也許還真有。
去找凱隆院長吧。

scripts.text:

Do I know you? Were you one of my students?
Oh, it doesn't matter anyway. You wouldn't be a Sage without graduating from this academy...
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
我們認識嗎？
你是我的學生？
算了，也不重要。
沒從這所學院畢業，你就不可能成為賢者...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
A Novice? Why is a novice here?
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
初心者？
初心者怎麼會來這裡？

scripts.text:

Welcome, I am in charge of historical studies here in the academy.
scripts.translation:

我負責學院的歷史研究。

很高興見到你。
我是薩菲恩·萊勒斯，接下來一段時間由我負責你的課程。

scripts.text:

[Saphien Layless]

You brought Yggdrasilberry!
scripts.translation:

[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
哦，東西帶來了嗎？
很好！
你帶來了天地樹果實！

scripts.text:

[Saphien Layless]
Hmm, did you prepare for class? Let's see...
Oh! So you brought me the Yggdrasil Seed?

我說過，帶一件與天地樹有關的物品來。

I will assist you with your writing.

I am afraid to say I already informed you of what you need.
scripts.translation:

看來你還沒準備好寫論文。
需要什麼，我已經告訴過你了。

scripts.text:

If you've finished writing your thesis, please bring it to the dean.
scripts.translation:

咦？
你不是該去找院長嗎？
論文寫完了，就請交給院長。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I am not sure if you have business with me, but please come back later.
I have some issues to think about..
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
不知道你找我有什麼事，不過請稍後再來。
我還有些問題要思考...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
In any case, you must study the past in order to better understand the present and to predict...the future.
This sentence contains all the truth of the world.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
無論如何，只有研究過去，才能更好地理解現在，並預測...未來。
這句話蘊含著世間的一切真理。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I guess you're treading the right path...
One of these days you'll look back to this moment and realize it changed your life.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
看來你正走在正確的道路上...
總有一天，回首此刻，你會發現它改變了你的人生。

scripts.text:

One whose life has many possibilities... 
How do you wish to lead your life?
scripts.translation:

你的人生還有無限可能...
你想怎樣度過這一生？

scripts.text:

No matter what you decide to be, everything depends on your choice.
May God bless you so that you can choose the path best for you...
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
無論你想成為什麼樣的人，一切都取決於自己的選擇。
願神保佑你，找到最適合自己的道路...

scripts.text:

Therefore, knowing the past means you will better understand the present and...the future.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
我們熟悉的這個世界，是歷代史料中記載的種種事件共同造就的。
正是歷史塑造了今天的世界。
因此，瞭解過去，才能更好地理解現在和...未來。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Reflect upon your past.
You will see your path in the future...
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
回顧自己的過去吧。
你會看清未來的道路...

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The subject you're studying is Yggdrasil.
So...do you even know what Yggdrasil is?
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
你的研究課題是天地樹。
那麼...你知道天地樹是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I know very well.
scripts.translation: 很清楚

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Okay then, what is Yggdrasil?
Please answer me.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
好，那天地樹是什麼？
請回答。

scripts.text: It's a name of a health item.
scripts.translation: 一種恢復物品的名字

scripts.text: It's the source of life in the world.
scripts.translation: 這個世界的生命之源

scripts.text: Suckah, I lied.
scripts.translation: 笨蛋，騙你的

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Wrong. {0}, you got - 10 points.
That's just one of the gifts from Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
錯了。
{0}，扣10分。
那只是天地樹的恩賜之一。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Yggdrasil is the name of the tree that is the source of life in this world.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹，是這個世界生命之源的名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
That's right. Yggdrasil, the so-called 'World Tree', 
is the name of the tree that has been the source of life in this world.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
沒錯。
天地樹，又稱“世界樹”，是這個世界的生命之源。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Great Schott...If you don't know, just say so.
By the way, {0}, you just got - 10 points for lying and for being wrong.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天哪...不知道就直說。
另外，{0}，你既撒了謊，又答錯了，扣10分。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Ah well, I expected you would know at least a little bit about Yggdrasil...
Yggdrasil is the name of the tree that is the source of life in this world.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
唉，我還以為你多少了解一點天地樹...
天地樹，是這個世界生命之源的名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Before we start the class, I'll need some reserve items.
It's for better understanding of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
上課前，需要準備一些物品。
這樣才能更好地瞭解天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Anything is fine as long as it's related to the Yggdrasil tree.
Seeds or fruits of the tree would be good. I know it's difficult to find, but please try.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
只要與天地樹有關，什麼都可以。
種子或果實就很合適。
我知道不好找，但還是請你盡力找找。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
When we have the reserve items, we will start the class.
Please come back.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
準備好物品，就可以開始上課了。
拿到後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Okay, now I am starting the class.
Listen carefully, I will not accept dozing off in the middle of class.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
好，現在開始上課。
仔細聽，課堂上不許打瞌睡。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Very well. Now I am starting the class..
Listen carefully, I will not accept dozing off in the middle of class.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
很好，現在開始上課...
仔細聽，課堂上不許打瞌睡。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
You can purchase this item from the town of Al De Baran! You didn't show any effort.
So, I must give you - 10 points, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
這東西在艾爾帕蘭就能買到！
你根本沒用心去找。
所以，{0}，扣10分。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Okay, now I am starting the class.
Listen carefully, I will not accept you dozing off in the middle of class, or any more slacking.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
好，現在開始上課。
仔細聽，不許打瞌睡，也不許再偷懶。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Tell me when you're ready.
Don't worry about being late, we professors are paid to wait around.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
準備好了就告訴我。
不必擔心遲到，我們教授可是領著薪水等人的。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The root of this world, Yggdrasil, is a gigantic tree.
It takes root all over the continent of Rune-Midgarts and its leaves reach the sky.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹是支撐著這個世界的巨樹。
它的根系遍佈盧恩·米德加茲大陸，枝葉直達天空。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Outside of this continent, there is a ocean where a giant snake named Yormungandr is coiled up.
The world as we know it consists of 3 places: Asgard, Midgard and Utgard.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
大陸之外是一片海洋，巨蛇耶夢加得盤踞其中。
我們所知的世界由三部分組成：阿斯加德、米德加爾特和烏特加德。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Utgard is where all the titans live.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
烏特加德是所有巨人居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Midgard is where all human beings live.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
米德加爾特是所有人類居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
And Asgard is where the gods reside...
An ash tree taking root in the middle of the Rune-Midgarts continent, that is Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
而阿斯加德，是眾神居住的地方...
紮根於盧恩·米德加茲大陸中央的那棵白蠟樹，就是天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
This continent was born from the heart of Ymir, and Yggdrasil holds the continent together by grasping it with its 3 roots.
These roots stretch into 3 different places.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
這片大陸誕生於尤彌爾的心臟，天地樹以三條根系緊緊抓住大陸，使其維繫在一起。
這三條根系分別伸向三個地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The first root reaches Asgard where the gods live and 
where we, mere humans, haven't yet explored or experienced.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
第一條根系伸向眾神居住的阿斯加德，那是我們凡人尚未涉足的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The second root reaches Jotunnheim where all the giants live.
We've been told this name many times through myths and legends.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
第二條根系伸向巨人居住的約頓海姆。
神話和傳說中，常常提到這個名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The third one reaches Niflheim.
That place is rumored to be covered with a thick, black fog.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
第三條根系伸向尼芙菲姆。
據說那裡籠罩著濃密的黑霧。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Items, such as Seed of Yggdrasil, Yggdrasilbrry and Leaf of Yggdrasil are
considered a part of Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹芽、天地樹果實和天地樹葉子等物品，都被認為是天地樹的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Yggdrasilberry has a fascinating scent that is rumored to
restore full HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹果實散發著迷人的香氣，據說能一次恢復全部HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The seed of Yggdrasil which has the fragrance of a blooming flower and the flavor of nut is rumored to
restore half of HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹芽有盛放鮮花的香氣和堅果的味道，據說能一次恢復一半的HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The leaf of Yggdrasil which is filled with vital force is rumored to
revive the dead, bringing them back to this world.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
天地樹葉子充滿生命力，據說能讓死者復活，重返這個世界。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Lastly... if by some chance you discover a way into Asgard in the future, 
I hope you will find the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
最後...如果將來你有幸找到通往阿斯加德的道路，希望你能找到天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Even though the story of the Yggdrasil tree only exists in myths and legends, 
we Sages are obligated to discover the truth of the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
雖說天地樹的故事只見於神話和傳說，但我們賢者有責任探明它的真相。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
That is the end of today's class.
Please record the articles you've learned today, and try to remember as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
今天的課就到這裡。
請記下今天學到的知識，並儘可能牢記。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
In the next class, you will write a thesis about Yggdrasil...
Please bring the following items to prepare for class.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
下節課，你要寫一篇關於天地樹的論文...
請準備以下物品，供上課使用。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 which will be used for holding the squid ink.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
^3355FF1個鳥羽毛^000000，用作筆
^3355FF1個動物外皮^000000，用作紙張
^3355FF1個瑪哪樹枝^000000，用於裝訂書籍
^3355FF1個墨汁^000000，用作墨水
^3355FF1個空瓶^000000，用於盛裝墨汁

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
I will help you to write your thesis when you're ready with all those items.
I am looking forward to the next class with you.
scripts.translation:
[薩菲恩·萊勒斯]
備齊這些物品後，我就會指導你撰寫論文。
期待下次與你上課。

[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
嗯？
找我有什麼事？
你對觀察魔物感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Welcome to my class, did you earn good results in the practical exam?
My name is Lucius Celsus, the expert of Biology.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
歡迎來上我的課。
實操考試成績不錯吧？
我是盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯，生物學專家。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You showed great effort to gather all of those.
Well, I am not sure if you gathered them by yourself or bought them from shops...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
收齊這些東西，看來你下了不少功夫。
不過，是自己收集的，還是從商店買來的，我就不知道了...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, you already forgot what I told you just a minute before?
What a nusance... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
什麼，才一分鐘就忘了我說的話？
真麻煩...這次給我仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Well done. So, did you watch insects while gathering those items?
Oh well, I believe you did a good job with the task.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
做得好。
收集這些物品時，有沒有觀察昆蟲？
好吧，我相信你把任務完成得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, you already forgot what I told you?
What a nuisance...listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
什麼，你已經忘了我說的話？
真麻煩...這次給我仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Zzz...Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
Zzz...Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Hmph. Lucky brat brought all of the items.
Well, I don't expect you to write an outrageously great thesis though...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
哼，你這幸運的小鬼，居然把東西都帶齊了。
不過，我可不指望你能寫出什麼驚世之作...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, are you sure that you're ready? No, I don't think so.
Oh well... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
什麼，你確定準備好了？
不，我看還沒有。
算了...這次給我仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What are you doing here, Go show your thesis to the dean!
Don't wasn't any more time here.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你還在這裡幹什麼？
快把論文交給院長！
別再在這裡浪費時間了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Wah~! My brain is gonna blow up soon! Why must I have to prepare all of these things?!
Who are you?! Don't disturb me, I'm busy!!
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
哇~！
我腦子都快炸了！
為什麼這些東西全都要我準備？！
你是誰？！
別打擾我，我忙著呢！！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You don't know how busy person I am...don't you?
If you're a Sage, you're supposed to know about me by now.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你不知道我有多忙，是吧？
既然是賢者，應該早就聽說過我了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You have too much time on your hands. Go explore some dungeons.
I think it will be more helpful than wasting your time on me.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你可真閒。
去探索地下城吧。
總比在我這裡浪費時間有用。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You'd better go out and play with your pals. 
This is not a place where you can fool around.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
出去和朋友玩吧。
這裡不是你胡鬧的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You're allowed to watch. However, do not disturb them by making any fuss.
And keep your hands off, some of these guys are way too dangerous to touch.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
看看可以，但別吵吵鬧鬧地驚擾它們。
也別亂碰，有些傢伙可是危險得很。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, if you catch any rare monsters in future, let me know.
I am willing to purchase those at any cost.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
對了，以後捕到稀有魔物，記得告訴我。
不管花多少錢，我都願意買。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Huh...how rude of you! You're expected to introduce yourself to me as soon as I greet you!
What is your name, young one?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
哼...真沒禮貌！
我一打招呼，你就該自報姓名！
年輕人，你叫什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
A fine name. It's nice to meet you.
So, are you aware of the subject you're studying?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
名字不錯。
很高興認識你。
那麼，你知道自己要研究什麼課題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
As you know, your topic of study is monsters.
How many times have you fought with monsters?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你也知道，自己的研究課題是魔物。
你和魔物戰鬥過多少次？

scripts.text: Well, I can't even count.
scripts.translation: 多到數不清

scripts.text: A few times, I guess...
scripts.translation: 大概幾次吧...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Oh shut up, you brat. Don't be so sure about yourself.
Even if you have much experience with monsters, you will have a hard time comprehending my lecture.
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, that's what I guessed about you. You're just book smart.
However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
閉嘴，小鬼。
別太自以為是。
就算你與魔物打過不少交道，想聽懂我的課也沒那麼容易。
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
果然不出我所料，你只懂書本上的知識。
不過，我相信你會遇到課上提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, that's what I guessed about you. You're just book smart.
However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
果然不出我所料，你只懂書本上的知識。
不過，我相信你會遇到課上提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Let's get started.
Make sure you're ready for the practical examination during my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
開始吧。
上課期間還會有實操考核，做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTentacle^000000,
5 ^3355FFSingle Cell^000000,
5 ^3355FFFish Tail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
去把以下物品帶來。
5個^3355FF觸手^000000
5個^3355FF單細胞^000000
5個^3355FF魚尾^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFClam Flesh^000000,
5 ^3355FFHeart of Mermaid^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
去把以下物品帶來。
5個^3355FF鉗子^000000
5個^3355FF蛤蜊肉^000000
5個^3355FF美人魚之心^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTendon^000000,
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFSharp Scale^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
去把以下物品帶來。
5個^3355FF肌腱^000000
5個^3355FF鉗子^000000
5個^3355FF銳利麟片^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I will proceed with the class when you bring those to me.
Have fun.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
帶來這些東西，我們再繼續上課。
玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Somehow the monsters that drop those items have something in common.
Can you tell me what that similarity is?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
掉落這些物品的魔物，有某種共同點。
能告訴我是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: They possess water property.
scripts.translation: 它們都是水屬性

scripts.text: They are fishes.
scripts.translation: 它們都是魚貝系

scripts.text: They are aggressive.
scripts.translation: 它們會主動攻擊

scripts.text: Um...they monsters.
scripts.translation: 呃...它們都是魔物

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
沒錯，它們既是水屬性，也是魚貝系魔物。
大多數魚貝系魔物生活在水下，因此屬於水屬性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
沒錯，它們既是水屬性，也是魚貝系魔物。
大多數魚貝系魔物生活在水下，因此屬於水屬性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
...I didn't know Phens were aggressive nowadays?
Or do Marina and Plankton team up to start a fight with you?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
...劍魚什麼時候也會主動攻擊了？
還是水母和漂浮蟲聯手找你打架？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
All the monsters from which you obtained these items are not agressive... get a grip.
They are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
掉落這些物品的魔物，全都不會主動攻擊...清醒點。
它們都是水屬性的魚貝系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What...! What are you here for!? You are here to study about specific monsters, microcephalic moron!
Sigh...they are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
什麼...！
你到底來幹什麼的！？
你是來研究特定魔物的，沒腦子的蠢貨！
Sigh...它們都是水屬性的魚貝系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Not all fish class monsters possess water property, but most of them do.
So which kind of magic would work best on most fish class monsters?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
魚貝系魔物並非全是水屬性，但大多數是。
那麼，對付大多數魚貝系魔物，哪種魔法最有效？

scripts.text: Lightening Bolt.
scripts.translation: 雷擊術

scripts.text: Fire Bolt.
scripts.translation: 火箭術

scripts.text: Thunder Storm.
scripts.translation: 雷暴術

scripts.text: Frost Diver.
scripts.translation: 冰錐術

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's right, Lightening Bolt, which possesses the wind property, works best on water property monsters.
Although you might want to be careful of monsters that recognize magic casting.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
沒錯，雷擊術是風屬性魔法，對水屬性魔物最有效。
不過，要小心那些會對施法作出反應的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What? Fire Bolt! Fire cannot beat water, you imbecile!
Most fishes are attributed with the water property. Therefore, they are weak to wind property magic spells. Don't you get it?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
什麼？
火箭術！
火可克不了水，蠢貨！
大多數魚貝系魔物都是水屬性，因此怕風屬性魔法。
還不明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yeah, Thunder Storm spell is fine... it's a wind property spell.
However, you will be in trouble if you use the spell in a poorly chosen spot.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
嗯，雷暴術也可以...它也是風屬性魔法。
不過，施放位置沒選好，可就麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I can't fathom such stupidity! This question asks you to choose a property that counters water! Don't you get it?
Logically, any magic spell possessing the water property cannot overcome the water atrribute monsters!
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
怎麼會這麼蠢！
題目要你選能剋制水屬性的魔法，明白嗎？
想想就知道，水屬性魔法怎麼能剋制水屬性魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, although some monsters such as Penomena or Aster are considered to be fish class monsters, 
they have a different property than the others. You'd better be careful with them.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
對了，梅納海葵、海星這些魔物雖屬魚貝系，屬性卻與其他魔物不同。
對付它們時要多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Okay, let me teach you about insect monsters.
Let's see... hmm... hmm...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
好，接下來講昆蟲系魔物。
讓我看看...嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:

Have fun.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
帶來這些東西，我們再繼續上課。
玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Insect class monsters do not share the same property most of the time, 
You must think twice before you cast a magic spell on an insect.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
昆蟲系魔物的屬性往往各不相同。
對它們施放魔法前，得先想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
It's remarkable that insects can detect hidden objects.
Therefore, any hiding skill such as the Hiding skill or Cloaking skill will not work on insect monsters.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
昆蟲能察覺隱藏的事物，這一點很厲害。
因此，隱匿、偽裝之類的隱藏技能，對昆蟲系魔物都無效。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Some insects form a group and live together.
They are controlled by the head of the group...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
有些昆蟲群居生活。
它們受群體首領的支配...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
For instance, Maya the queen ant...
Mistress, the queen of hornets,
or Golden Thiefbug, the king of thiefbugs...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
比如蟻群的女王蟻后...
黃蜂的女王蜂后，
還有盜蟲之王黃金蟲...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You cannot beat those boss monsters alone, 
you'd better form a party if you want to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
這些首領魔物，靠你一個人可打不過。
想挑戰它們，最好先組隊。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's the end of my class...it's time for you to write a thesis.
Bring me following items for writing the thesis.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
課就上到這裡...接下來該寫論文了。
把以下寫論文要用的物品帶來。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 which will be used for holding squid ink.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
^3355FF1個鳥羽毛^000000，用作筆
^3355FF1個動物外皮^000000，用作紙張
^3355FF1個瑪哪樹枝^000000，用於裝訂書籍

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I will help you in writing the thesis when you bring all of those items.
You're almost there. Isn't learning easy?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
東西帶齊，我就指導你寫論文。
馬上就完成了。
學習是不是很簡單？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Well, if you really want to write it by yourself, I can let you handle it but...
I will give you a work of staggering genius. Just make a copy of it under your name.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你真想自己寫，我也可以讓你來，不過...
我會給你一篇才華橫溢的傑作。
照抄一份，署上你的名字就行。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You got a problem with that? Tough, that's my style.
Just do what I say.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
有意見？
忍著，這就是我的風格。
照我說的做。

scripts.translation: 必須瞭解每種魔物的屬性

scripts.translation:

寫完了？
好，那就到這裡。
你再也沒有重寫論文的機會，好好保管。

Then, he will let you graduate from the academy. See you.
scripts.translation:

把這篇傑作拿給院長看。
他就會准許你畢業。
再見。

[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
你一直做得不錯，這件事應該難不倒你。
快去把東西拿來。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
It seems you have too much time on your hands. Okay, I will assign you some tasks.
Hahaha, did you say no? Alright then, fine. Scram.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
看來你閒得很。
好，我給你安排點任務。
Hahaha，不願意？
行，那就滾吧。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
If you just want to watch monsters here, fine with me...
Just don't ask me any questions.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯·塞爾蘇斯]
只是在這裡看看魔物，倒也無妨...
別問我問題就行。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, hello there! What brings you here again, sweetie?
Oh, I see... you're just excited because you finally became a Sage? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Tee hee，你好呀！
親愛的，怎麼又來了？
哦，明白了...終於成了賢者，太興奮了吧？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well, aren't you the cutest little Novice~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哎呀，真是個可愛的小初心者~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hey there, tee hee, how's it going sailor?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
嗨，tee hee，水手，最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hello~? Nice to meet you, tee hee.
Did you come to see me? Oh, you're a student!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
你好~？
很高興見到你，tee hee。
是來看我的嗎？
哦，原來是學生！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought them all~ thank you~
Oh, can you wait a little bit? I need to do something before we start. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哦~真貼心！
東西全帶來了~謝謝~
能稍等一下嗎？
開始前，我還得做點事情。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
You don't have all the items? And here I was, getting all hot and bothered.
Go on, sweetheart, and hurry baaack~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
東西沒帶齊？
虧我還滿心期待，心癢難耐呢。
去吧，親愛的，快點回~來~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought them all~ Oh thank you~
Well now, let's get down to business. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哦~真貼心！
東西全帶來了~謝謝~
好啦，開始辦正事吧。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, precious...are you trying to fool me? Tee hee~
I hope you didn't sell the elemental ores I gave you? Naughty naughty~ Don't you know diamonds are a girl's best friend? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
寶貝，怎麼還在這裡...想糊弄我嗎？
Tee hee~
你沒把我給你的元素礦石賣掉吧？
真調皮~不知道鑽石是女孩最好的朋友嗎？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought some Holy Water~ thanks honey~
Oh righty, we should start class. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哦~真貼心！
帶來聖水了~謝謝，親愛的~
好啦，該上課了。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, precious...are you playing games? Tee hee.
Oh, poor dear. Did you already forget what I told you? Do you want me to remind you? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
寶貝，怎麼還在這裡...跟我鬧著玩呢？
Tee hee。
哦，可憐的孩子。
已經忘了我的話嗎？
要我提醒一下？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
So...do you have the time? I'm kidding, girlfriend!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
那麼...有空嗎？
開玩笑的啦，姐妹！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay~ so its now or never~ tee hee~
I taught you everything I know. Don't be nervous, you'll be okay~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
好啦~機不可失哦~tee hee~
我知道的都教給你了。
別緊張，你一定沒問題~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you still doing here, sweet cheeks? Tee hee~
Oh, poor dear. Did you already forget what I told you? Do you want me to remind you? Not a problem, tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
甜心，怎麼還在這裡？
Tee hee~
哦，可憐的孩子。
已經忘了我的話嗎？
要我提醒一下？
沒問題，tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, dearie? Don't you want to meet the dean and show him your stuff?
Take it from me, boys like him won't wait for you forever, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
親愛的，怎麼還在這裡？
不去找院長，讓他看看你的成果嗎？
聽我的，像他那樣的男孩子，可不會一直等你哦，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well well...what do we have here?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哎呀呀...這是誰來了？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh well, although you have become a Sage, you're just doing the same thing, tee hee...we're mages down to the core!
We're way better than any other class because we're pretty good with our heads, you know?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
雖說成了賢者，做的還是老本行，tee hee...我們骨子裡都是魔法師！
我們頭腦聰明，所以比其他職業都厲害，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay, is there anything you want to talk about?
Oh dearie, don't be nervous...where's your sense of adventure?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
好啦，有什麼想聊的嗎？
親愛的，別緊張...你的冒險精神呢？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, sweetcakes? Do you just come over to see what's in here?
Do you want some candy? Candy, my precious? Tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
甜心，來做什麼呀？
只是來看看這裡有什麼嗎？
想吃糖嗎？
寶貝，要糖嗎？
Tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh gosh...Sorry, I thought I had some...
But I've got other treats, you catch my drift?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哎呀...抱歉，我還以為有糖呢...
不過，我還有別的好東西招待你，懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Did you come here to look around? Huh...?
Well, if you're not here for business, you must be here...
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
是來參觀的嗎？
嗯...？
既然不是來辦正事，那一定是來...

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...for PLEASURE.
Hey wait! Come back~!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
...找樂子的。
嘿，等等！
回來~！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, I am the Professor in charge of you, Abecee George.
So...aren't you happy to be with me, dearie? Aren't you gay? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Tee hee，我是指導你的教授，艾貝西·喬治。
親愛的...和我在一起不開心嗎？
不快樂嗎？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
However, before we get start class, I need you to do me...a favor.
Don't be scared, its just an eensy weensy favor. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
不過，上課前得請你幫我...一個忙。
別怕，只是個小小的忙。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please bring me ^3355FF30 Stone^000000, that's all.
It's not so hard, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
只要帶來^3355FF30個寶石原石^000000就好。
不難吧？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Why don't you ask a thief pal for help?
We'll start the class when you bring me those stones~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
不妨找個盜賊朋友幫忙？
把寶石原石帶來，我們就開始上課~Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hocus-focus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Hocus-focus!!

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hocus~focus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Hocus~focus!!

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Ho~cus~fo~cus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Ho~cus~fo~cus!!

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, you naughty stone~
Only 3 of them worked for me. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
Tee hee，調皮的石頭們~
只有3個成功了呢。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Here's my other favor to ask of you. Oh, are those tears of...joy?
Oh, I'm sooo excited too! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
還得請你幫個忙。
哦，流淚了...喜極而泣嗎？
我也好~興奮！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I will give you these elemental ores...but...they are not for free.
Whoa there cowboy! Don't pull out so soon~ Listen, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
這些元素礦石給你...不過...可不是白送的。
別急，牛仔！
別這麼快就走嘛~聽我說，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please make arrows using these items and bring them to me, pretty please~
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFStone Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFWind Arrow^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
請用這些材料製作箭矢，再帶給我，拜託啦~
50支^3355FF水靈箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF地靈箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF風靈箭矢^000000

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Ask any of your Archer friends if you know any.
I am looking forward to seeing you again, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
有認識的弓箭手朋友，就請他們幫忙吧。
期待再見到你，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I asked you to bring ^3355FF30 Stone^000000.
There are many out there, so you won't have too hard a time getting them~ tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
我讓你帶來^3355FF30個寶石原石^000000。
外面多得很，找起來應該不難~tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I'll say something, and you just write everything down.
Don't forget to underline the important sentences~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
我說，你記，把內容全記下來。
重要的句子，別忘了畫上下劃線~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water property magic is sooo strong against the fire property.
Just remember those burly, sexay fire fighters, shall we say, putting out that fire with water. Ooh, wet!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
水屬性魔法對火屬性可強~了。
想想那些魁梧又性感的消防員，用水把火撲滅。
哦，溼漉漉的！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Wind property magic totally dominates the water property! Oh, yes~
Think of a hot flash, and by that I mean ligntening, striking a lake. Oh, I'm bad!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
風屬性魔法完全壓制水屬性！
哦，沒錯~
想想那道熾熱的閃光——我說的是閃電——擊中湖面的情景。
哦，我真壞！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
In terms of strength, magic with earth property goes on top of wind property magic! Ho~~
Just think of how the wind passionately beats against the cliffside near the Lookout Point or Lover's Lane. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
論威力，地屬性魔法可是壓在風屬性魔法上面的！
Ho~~
想想瞭望點或情人小徑附近，風如何熱烈地拍打懸崖。
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is strong against earth property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the bearskin, in the dark~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
火屬性魔法剋制地屬性！
Tee hee~
想想生長於大地的木材，在溫暖的壁爐裡燃燒。
在熊皮上，在黑暗中~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...Oh my gosh! Time flies sooo fast!
Let's call it a day, dear, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
...天哪！
時間過得好~快！
親愛的，今天就到這裡吧，tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
When you come to the next class, bring ^3355FF1 Holy Water^000000~
I hope you have at least one Priest friend. Oh, you don't? Well, it couldn't hurt to get friendly with one.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
下次上課，帶來^3355FF1瓶聖水^000000~
希望你至少認識一位牧師。
哦，不認識？
那就交個牧師朋友嘛。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFStone Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFWind Arrow^000000.
Ask your Archer friend if you have one~ tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
50支^3355FF水靈箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF地靈箭矢^000000
50支^3355FF風靈箭矢^000000
有弓箭手朋友，就請他們幫忙吧~tee hee。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Just Like last time, I will speak and you just write down everything I say.
Even if you don't understand, just pretend and go with the flow, alright? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
和上次一樣，我說什麼，你就全部記下來。
聽不懂也裝作聽懂，順著我來，好嗎？
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water Magic is weak against wind property! Yes, that's right~
Just remember why you don't keep the electric fan around when you're taking a hot bubble bath. Ooh! So electric!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
水屬性魔法不擅長對付風屬性！
沒錯~
想想泡熱水泡泡浴時，為什麼不能把電風扇放在旁邊。
哦！
真來電！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with the wind property is weak against earth property!
Think of how the wind can't, shall we say, penetrate a mud facial mask~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
風屬性魔法不擅長對付地屬性！
想想風怎麼也穿不透泥面膜~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with earth property is weak against fire property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the be--oh? I said that already? Oh poopy.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
地屬性魔法不擅長對付火屬性！
Tee hee~
想想生長於大地的木材，在溫暖的壁爐裡燃燒。
在熊——哦？
說過了？
哎呀，真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is weak against water property! Yes~
When things get flaming hot, it's best to splash things in cold water. Don't you agree~?
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
火屬性魔法不擅長對付水屬性！
沒錯~
熱得像著火一樣時，最好潑點冷水。
你說是不是~？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh, it's the end of the class~ tee hee.
So? Do you think you've learned a lot? You can thank me, honey!
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
哦，下課了~tee hee。
怎麼樣？
是不是學到了很多？
親愛的，可以好好感謝我啦！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well, that's it. You can write your thesis with what I've taught you!
Tee hee~ yes! Yes! I am the best teacher in the world! Oh, I am on fire! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
好啦，就這樣。
用我教你的知識寫論文吧！
Tee hee~沒錯！
沒錯！
我是世上最棒的老師！
哦，我真是狀態火熱！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay, please gather these items so you can write the thesis, dear~ Tee hee~
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 to keep that Squid Ink from splashing.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
親愛的，收齊這些物品，就能寫論文了~Tee hee~
^3355FF1個鳥羽毛^000000，用作筆
^3355FF1個動物外皮^000000，用作紙張
^3355FF1個瑪哪樹枝^000000，用於裝訂書籍
^3355FF1個墨汁^000000，用作墨水
^3355FF1個空瓶^000000，防止墨汁濺出來

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
So get on out there cowboy and hurry back~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
快去吧，牛仔，早去早回~Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
^3355FF1 Holy Water^000000,
It couldn't hurt to get friendly with an Aco or Priest...tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾貝西·喬治]
^3355FF1瓶聖水^000000
交個服事或牧師朋友，總沒壞處...tee hee。
